```python
    t = t * x
    t = F.hardswish(t)
    return F.normalize(t, dim=0)

eager = m(*args)
torch._dynamo.reset()
compiled = torch.compile(m, backend='inductor')(*args)
print('eager   :', eager)
print('compiled:', compiled)
```
